meta.author: Galimzhan Zhandos (CS-2427)
meta.note: Each Kill Chain stage is mapped to the ATT&CK techniques that describe it. 'evidence' links the stage to public reporting and to my own Week 2-3 data.

cases.title: Classiscam: fake 'OLX delivery' scam against sellers on OLX.kz
cases.confidence: high (documented by Group-IB; Kazakh OLX version seen since August 2020)
sources: Group-IB, Unmasking the Classiscam in Central Asia (2025, Uzbekistan/Kyrgyzstan, same scheme next door): https://www.group-ib.com/blog/unmasking-the-classiscam-in-central-asia/

stages.what_happens: A 'worker' browses OLX.kz for sellers with fresh ads (electronics, furniture) and takes their name and phone number from the ad.
stages.evidence: Group-IB: workers pick targets from classifieds and collect name, address, phone.

stages.what_happens: The worker asks the gang's Telegram bot to generate a phishing set (fake 'OLX delivery', payment and refund pages) on a lookalike domain registered by the admins.
stages.evidence: My Week 2 data: olxkz[.]pay-sacure4ds[.]ru = brand keyword + fake '3-D Secure' on a cheap .ru domain. Group-IB: Telegram bots build the whole phishing set in minutes.

stages.what_happens: Posing as a buyer, the scammer writes in OLX chat, moves the victim to WhatsApp, Viber or Telegram and sends the link: 'I already paid, receive the money here'.
stages.evidence: Group-IB: victims are moved from the platform chat to messengers before the link is sent.

stages.what_happens: No software bug is exploited. The 'exploit' is social engineering: the victim opens the link and types card number, CVV and the 3-D Secure SMS code on the fake page.
stages.evidence: Fake 3-D Secure page (pay-sacure4ds). Group-IB 2023: newer kits also show fake bank login pages and check the card balance.

stages.what_happens: Nothing is installed on the victim's device. This stage is ABSENT for this attack; persistence is replaced by abusing the stolen card or bank login.
stages.evidence: Only in the 'fake bank login' variant (Group-IB 2023), where the stolen online-banking login is reused.

stages.what_happens: The 'C2' is the gang's Telegram bot and panel: every entered card and SMS code is pushed to the worker in real time so they can use it before it expires.
stages.evidence: Group-IB: bots and admin panels coordinate workers. No implant on the victim, so this is adversary-side C2.

stages.what_happens: Money is withdrawn from the card. A 'caller' posing as OLX support may then offer a 'refund' to steal a second time. Profits are split, most of it goes to the worker.
stages.evidence: Group-IB 2023: 393 groups with 38,000+ members, $64.5M earned (H1 2020 - H1 2023), average loss $353.

cases.title: Cluster C01: Apple ID phishing kit on .com.kz lookalikes (from my Week 3 correlation)
cases.confidence: medium (my own data; the iServer link is a hypothesis)
sources: My Week 3 correlation: 5 domains share the kit path /m/sing/*

Group-IB / Europol, Operation Kaerb against iServer (Sep 2024): https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/group-ib-contributes-to-international-operation-kaerb-that-led-to-the-arrest-of-the-masterminds-behind-the-iserver-phishing-as-a-service-platform-which-claimed-more-than-483-000-victims-globally-302253202.html

stages.what_happens: Hypothesis: the operator holds a stolen iPhone and reads the owner's contact number and language from Lost Mode.
stages.evidence: iServer workflow (Group-IB): victim details come from the device in Lost Mode.

stages.what_happens: Registers Apple-themed domains in .com.kz and deploys the same kit on each.
stages.evidence: appleid, appleoficial, idapple, miaccount, soporteapple [.]com[.]kz, same path /m/sing/*

stages.what_happens: Short SMS link: 'Your iPhone was found, see its location'. The short /m/<token> path is typical for SMS links.
The owner opens the fake 'Find My / Apple ID' page and enters the Apple ID password.
stages.evidence: Spanish words in domains (soporte, oficial) fit the Spanish-speaking iServer ecosystem.

stages.what_happens: No malware. The stolen Apple ID is used directly. Stage ABSENT on the victim side.
stages.evidence: Hypothesis based on the kit's purpose.

stages.what_happens: The kit's panel checks the password and sends it to the operator.
The operator removes the iPhone from the owner's Apple ID (Activation Lock off) and resells the phone.

courses_of_action.detect: Monitor CT logs / feeds for new brand-keyword domains
courses_of_action.deny: Hide seller phone numbers on OLX by default
courses_of_action.deceive: Honeypot ads to attract scammers and collect their links

courses_of_action.detect: Sigma DNS rule dns_kz_brand_lookalike (Week 3); MISP event with kit clusters
courses_of_action.deny: Registrar checks for brand names in new domains

courses_of_action.detect: Platform chat filter for 'pay/receive money' links and off-platform moves
courses_of_action.deny: Block known phishing domains (blocklist_domains.txt) in DNS / browsers
courses_of_action.disrupt: In-app warning when a link is sent in chat

courses_of_action.deny: User awareness: to receive money a seller never needs to enter CVV or an SMS code

courses_of_action.detect: Bank / Apple: new device or new login location alert
courses_of_action.deny: Strong 2FA not based on SMS (push in bank app)

courses_of_action.detect: Threat intel on Telegram bot names (MISP)
courses_of_action.deceive: Feed fake card data to the panel (canary cards)

courses_of_action.detect: Bank anti-fraud: card-not-present payment right after a 3-DS code request
courses_of_action.disrupt: Instant card block via bank app
courses_of_action.degrade: Delay of large transfers to new recipients
